_meta.purpose: The 7 GGUF engines and 3 resident small models (ATLAS_FRAMEWORK_REVIEW.md Sections 4.1, 4.3, 5.1, 5.3; CONVENTIONS.md §8 order). Read by phase2/engine-env.py, phase2/04-memory.sh, phase3-models.sh and the orchestrator's Engine Arbiter.
_meta.port_rule: port = LLAMA_PORT_BASE + index, index 1..10 in list order (CONVENTIONS.md §8: 8101..8110). The port field below is the value for LLAMA_PORT_BASE=8100; engine-env.py recomputes it from the live setting.
_meta.ctx_rule: ctx_size is the TOTAL KV pool split across slots (llama-cpp-vulkan research §0.7: n_ctx_seq = n_ctx / n_parallel). ctx_per_slot is informational. Research conflict 9.
_meta.files_rule: files[] is VERBATIM from gguf-models.md §13. sha256 is null unless the research recovered it from an HF blob-page snippet; every hash, verified or not, is re-read from https://huggingface.co/api/models/<repo>/tree/main[/<subdir>] (lfs.oid, lfs.size) at pull time and recorded in <models>/<key>/MANIFEST.json (gguf-models.md §0, §11.1, §12 item 7). verify=unverified means hf_download is called with the tree-API hash only; verify=research-snippet means the tree-API hash is also compared with the snippet value and a mismatch is logged loudly.
_meta.enumerate_rule: When files[] is empty, the pull step lists the tree (subdir when set) and takes every LFS entry whose basename matches enumerate_pattern (fnmatch, case-insensitive). model_file_pattern selects the file passed to --model (first shard); for single-file models it equals the file name.
_meta.layout_rule: Every file lands flat in $ATLAS_SRV/models/<key>/<basename> (shards must share a directory for llama.cpp to find them). join_into names a file that the pull step must cat-join from files[] in order (raw byte splits, gguf-models.md §8) and whose size must equal the sum of the parts.
_meta.kv_rule: kv_class q8_0 or q4_0 is the Section 4.3 setting; f16 is llama.cpp's default. kv_ladder (Apex engine only) is the Phase 3 order of attempts with a coherence check; the winning type is written to $ATLAS_ETC/engines/overrides.json and engine-env.py re-renders the env file (gguf-models.md §6, §12 item 2).
_meta.parallel_rule: parallel is the explicit --parallel (never auto: gguf-models.md §1.3). parallel_coresident and ctx_size_coresident apply when the vision engine is loaded beside gpt-oss-120b (Section 4.1, 4.3).
_meta.extra_args_rule: extra_args tokens are passed verbatim after the generated flags; no token may contain whitespace, a quote of either kind or a backslash, because systemd splits an unquoted $ARGS at whitespace WITH quotes respected and then removed (systemd.service(5), 'Command lines'), so a JSON token would lose its double quotes (engine-env.py enforces this). --reasoning-format is not passed: its default is auto (VERIFIED) and only none|deepseek|deepseek-legacy are verified as explicit values.
_meta.env_rule: env is a map of extra KEY=VALUE lines written verbatim into the engine env file for options whose value cannot travel through $ARGS (JSON). Every LLAMA_ARG_* variable is honoured by llama-server itself (llama-cpp-vulkan.md §3). Values may contain double quotes but not single quotes, backslashes or newlines.
_meta.research: gguf-models.md (2026-09-22) and llama-cpp-vulkan.md (2026-09-22); llama.cpp pinned at tag v0.4.1 (commit b29c606e28a01b1bc8c1351026a0fa6e616bf6c4) which post-dates every first-support build in gguf-models.md §1.2.

engines.role: Default resident engine. Ren, Helena, Victor, Gideon, Minerva (Section 5.1, 6.2)
engines.notes: SWA + attention sinks: the iswa cache prints TWO llama_kv_cache: size = ... lines (both must show q4_0). Sampling per openai/gpt-oss README (temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, no repetition penalty). ctx_train 131072 per the gpt-oss guide; 262144 total = 32k per slot across 8 slots (Section 4.3).

engines.role: Valerie default; Ren and Arthur on explicit override (Section 5.1, 6.2)
engines.notes: CONFLICT with Section 5.1 'MXFP4, native' (gguf-models.md §12 item 1): abliteration edits BF16 weights, so this GGUF is a llama-quantize MXFP4_MOE re-quantisation of Huihui-gpt-oss-120b-BF16-abliterated-v2, same 63.4 GB and speed, not bit-identical experts. File name(s) are enumerated from the tree API at pull time (research conflict e).

engines.min_llama_cpp_note: b8295 is the first tag carrying PR #20411 (gguf-models.md audit item 4; the pre-audit text said b8297, two tags later). The pinned v0.4.1 build satisfies both.
engines.known_issue: llama.cpp issue #20732: intermittent GPU memory fault on Vulkan/HIP at ~20k-token prompts (closed, not planned). The Phase 3 8k prefill test must health-check the server afterwards and record a V10 warn with the issue number, never hang (research conflict f).
engines.notes: Hybrid Mamba-2/attention/latent MoE: q8_0 applies to the attention layers only; llama_memory_recurrent prints R (f32) S (f32), which is expected. Active parameters 12B (A12B), Section 5.1 says 12.7B. Shards enumerated from the Q8_0/ folder at pull time (expected 3). footprint_gb is the Section 4.1 upper figure (120-123).

engines.role: Override engine for long documents and future languages (Section 5.1, 6.2)
engines.notes: Hybrid Gated-DeltaNet/attention: q8_0 on the attention layers, recurrent state f32 (expected). 262144 native context. Thinking on by default; --reasoning-format auto extracts it. The repo's mmproj-F16.gguf is not pulled (text-only engine here).

engines.role: Deep Think deep tier, TF_OMEGA, strong cross-checks. Runs alone (Section 4.2 rule 7, 5.1)
engines.known_issue: Quantised KV on deepseek4 disputed (issues #25382, #26423; PR #25391 unmerged): Phase 3 ladders f16 -> q8_0 -> q4_0 with a coherence prompt at each rung, records V4 as '<type> applied and coherent' for the best rung, writes the winner to overrides.json. An f16-only result caps ctx_size at ctx_size_f16_cap (~10 GB of cache beside 155 GB of weights) and records V22 pass with a note. --parallel MUST be explicit (issue #26654). Kernel 7.x DeviceLost needs amdgpu.lockup_timeout=10000,60000,10000,10000 (issue #25664, Phase 1 GRUB).
engines.notes: The 0731 checkpoint supersedes the April preview (research conflict b). Four llama_kv_cache lines (raw, CSA, HCA, indexer) plus f32 compressor states. The optional DSpark drafter at the repo root is NOT pulled on Day 1. Context capped: only 10-15 GB remain beside 155 GB of weights (Section 4.1, 4.3, Appendix B).

engines.role: The sole vision engine: documents, drawings, screenshots, scans. May be co-resident with gpt-oss-120b (Section 5.1, 15.2, 4.1)
engines.licence: qwen (Qwen License, NOT apache-2.0 — gguf-models.md §12 item 10; unverified)
engines.notes: Section 5.1 says ~3 tok/s (dense 72B at Q8_0). 32k native context; 8 slots x 32k alone, 2 slots x 32k (65536 total) while co-resident with gpt-oss-120b (Section 4.3). Projector offloaded to the GPU by default (--mmproj-offload).

engines.display_name: Meditron-70B (Q8_0, joined from raw byte splits)
engines.role: Secondary medical cross-check for Minerva only (Section 5.1 D12, 6.2)
engines.notes: Section 5.1 says ~3 tok/s. Llama-2 base with a 4096 training context (epfLLM/meditron README): --parallel 1 with the whole 4096 pool is the only sensible split (Section 4.3 '8 except where noted'). The two TheBloke files are raw byte splits, not llama.cpp shards: cat-joined in order a,b into meditron-70b.Q8_0.gguf and the joined size must equal the sum (research conflict d).

engines.role: Always resident. Eleanor, the 4-Way Router's classifier, LightRAG extraction (Section 5.3, 6.2, 10.2)
engines.notes: Pulled in Phase 2 step 4 and verified at the Phase 2 gate (V10, verify/v10a-router-resident.sh). Thinking off for immediate classification answers (gguf-models.md §9.1). Never counted against the engine budget (Section 4.1 resident set).

engines.role: Always resident. Vector Cortex embeddings, 1024-dim dense, 8192-token inputs (Section 5.3, 10.1)
